{{Top|leg}}
'''Creeping vines''' were a type of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skako/Legends|Skako]]. They could grow up to a hundred [[Foot/Legends|feet]] thick and could wrap around buildings for thousands of miles. [[Octuptarra/Legends|Octuptarras]] were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of creature that would climb along the vines.<ref name="PH:S">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/PHSkako|series=Planet Hoppers|text=Skako}}</ref>
